Lee · Listen & Shadow 24

The Last Project
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE PROJECT
👤 Brian
What was the last project you finished?
마지막으로 끝낸 프로젝트가 뭐였어요?
last — 마지막 · project — 프로젝트 · finish — 끝내다
💬 Lee
It was a hackathon for GS Group.
GS그룹 해커톤이었어요.
hackathon — 해커톤 · for — ~를 위한
💬 Lee
It was supposed to be in a large venue, but they moved it to a smaller one for safety reasons.
원래는 큰 장소였는데, 안전 문제로 작은 데로 바뀌었어요.
be supposed to — ~하기로 되어 있다 · venue — 장소 · safety — 안전
같은 패턴으로 — It was supposed to start at nine, but they moved it to ten. · I was supposed to go, but I stayed home.
💬 Lee
It was at the InterContinental Seoul.
인터컨티넨탈 서울에서 했어요.
at — ~에서 (장소)
💬 Lee
The space was about three meters wide.
공간은 폭이 3미터 정도였어요.
space — 공간 · wide — 폭이 ~인
같은 패턴으로 — The room was about ten meters long. · The table is about a meter wide.
💬 Lee
The concept was a relaxing room.
콘셉트는 편안한 방이었어요.
concept — 콘셉트 · relaxing — 편안하게 해주는
PART 2 · HOW IT STARTED
👤 Brian
How did they find you?
어떻게 찾아왔어요?
find — 찾다
💬 Lee
They found us on Instagram.
저희 회사 인스타그램을 봤어요.
on Instagram — 인스타그램에서
💬 Lee
Actually, they'd already checked our website and Instagram.
사실 웹사이트랑 인스타를 이미 다 봤더라고요.
actually — 사실 · already — 이미 · check — 확인하다
같은 패턴으로 — Actually, she'd already booked the hotel. · Actually, I'd already eaten.
💬 Lee
They sent us an inquiry by email, and we sent them a quote.
문의 이메일을 보내서, 저희가 검토하고 견적을 드렸어요.
inquiry — 문의 · by email — 이메일로 · quote — 견적
💬 Lee
They wanted content and a projector rental.
콘텐츠랑 프로젝터 렌탈을 원했어요.
content — 콘텐츠 · rental — 대여
💬 Lee
It took them two to five days to decide.
결정하는 데 2~5일 걸렸어요.
take — (시간이) 걸리다 · decide — 결정하다
같은 패턴으로 — It took us a week to finish. · It took me an hour to get here.
PART 3 · THE HARD PART
👤 Brian
Did anything go wrong?
뭐가 잘못됐어요?
go wrong — 잘못되다
💬 Lee
Something went wrong with the projector connection.
프로젝터 연결에 문제가 생겼어요.
something — 무언가 · connection — 연결
같은 패턴으로 — Something went wrong with the sound. · Something went wrong with my phone.
💬 Lee
We'll fix it after the event.
행사 끝나면 가서 고칠 거예요.
fix — 고치다 · after — ~ 후에
💬 Lee
Next time, I'd use a projector cover so it's less visible.
다음엔 프로젝터 커버를 써서 덜 보이게 할 거예요.
next time — 다음번에 · cover — 덮개 · visible — 눈에 보이는
같은 패턴으로 — Next time, I'd book earlier. · Next time, I'd bring an umbrella.
PART 4 · WHAT'S NEXT
👤 Brian
What's next?
다음은 뭐예요?
next — 다음
💬 Lee
I met someone new in my marketing class.
마케팅 수업에서 새로운 사람을 만났어요.
someone new — 새로운 사람 · in — ~에서 (수업 안에서)
💬 Lee
He's opening a new resort in Gapyeong.
가평에 새 리조트를 열어요.
open — 열다 · resort — 리조트
💬 Lee
He asked me to look at a quote he got.
받은 견적을 봐달라고 했어요.
ask A to — A에게 ~해달라고 하다 · look at — 보다
같은 패턴으로 — She asked me to check the file. · My mom asked me to call her.
💬 Lee
Then he asked for a quote from Beam Monster, so I'm sending it today.
그리고 빔몬스터 견적도 보내달래요. 오늘 보내요.
ask for — 요청하다 · from — ~로부터 · so — 그래서
PART 5 · SATURDAY NIGHT
👤 Brian
What did you do last weekend?
주말엔 뭐 했어요?
last weekend — 지난 주말
💬 Lee
I went to Itaewon — first a restaurant, then a bar, then a pub.
이태원 갔어요. 식당, 바, 펍 순서로.
first — 먼저 · then — 그다음
같은 패턴으로 — First coffee, then the gym, then work. · First Seoul, then Busan, then home.
💬 Lee
I talked with a lot of foreigners. I tried to use what I'd learned.
외국인들이랑 얘기 많이 했어요. 배운 거 써보려고 했어요.
foreigner — 외국인 · try to — ~하려고 하다 · what I'd learned — 배운 것
💬 Lee
It made me want to speak better.
더 잘 말하고 싶어졌어요.
make A want to — A가 ~하고 싶게 만들다
같은 패턴으로 — It made me want to travel. · That movie made me want to cook.
느리게 25/25 · 보통 25/25
